headline: Abated and denied fiscal year 2026 property tax amounts and settled two fiscal year 2025 Appellate Tax Board cases.
summary: The board settled two Fiscal Year 2025 Appellate Tax Board cases with abatements, then voted on Fiscal Year 2026 property tax abatements, approving some and denying others. The board also reviewed and approved new Statutory and Community Preservation Act Exemption Applications for Fiscal Year 2026.
decisions: Settled Fiscal Year 2025 Appellate Tax Board case for 37 Enon St (Map 92 Lot 59), abating $615.33.
Settled Fiscal Year 2025 Appellate Tax Board case for 224 Elliott St (Map 19 Lot 105), abating $7,662.66.
Voted to abate $803.89 for Fiscal Year 2026 on property at 18 Sturtevant St (Map 29 Lot 145).
Voted to abate $1,202.47 for Fiscal Year 2026 on property at 19 Hale Park Ave (Map 22 Lot 10).
Voted to abate $17,572.85 for Fiscal Year 2026 on property at 224 Elliott St (Map 19 Lot 105).
Voted to abate $9,180.85 for Fiscal Year 2026 on property at 37 Enon St (Map 92 Lot 59).
Voted to deny Fiscal Year 2026 abatement for property at 20 Colon St (Map 31 Lot 13).
Voted to deny Fiscal Year 2026 abatement for property at 138 Conant St (Map 52 Lot 82).
Voted to deny Fiscal Year 2026 abatement for property at 152 Conant St (Map 52 Lot 83).
Voted to deny Fiscal Year 2026 abatement for property at 16 Dodge St (Map 53 Lot 166).
Voted to deny Fiscal Year 2026 abatement for property at 87 Herrick St (Map 43 Lot 107A).
Voted to deny Fiscal Year 2026 abatement for property at 131-135 Cabot St (Map 5 Lot 247).
Voted to deny Fiscal Year 2026 abatement for property at 105 Cherry Hill Dr (Map 52 Lot 101).
Reviewed and approved new Statutory Exemption Applications for Fiscal Year 2026.
Reviewed and approved new Community Preservation Act Exemption Applications for Fiscal Year 2026.
